title: Nova
subtitle: The radiant cut does what it was made for — it takes color and multiplies it. Fancy Yellow doesn't sit quietly in a setting. It radiates.
description: The yellow gold bezel is not decoration — it's amplification. It pulls the color down into the metal, makes the whole ring feel like it was carved from sunlight. Then the white diamond halo shifts the register — crisp white brilliance wrapping deep yellow warmth.
